interpretation: For cross X owned by end E of T, otherEnds = T.endFeature excluding E, not X
binary: The featuring domain is the type intersection of the single other end
n_ary: Cartesian product over the type intersections of every other end in endFeature order; retain specialization of inherited/redefined cross domains
